article: Unsplashの写真をブログで使う前に確認したいライセンスと権利
scope: Compared the entire Japanese source and all twelve localized files, including title, description, publication metadata, complete prose, license statements, restrictions, third-party rights, Unsplash+ distinction, and reference links.
findings: Removed duplicate future date; retained the 2023-04-02 original publication timestamp and recorded lastmod 2026-11-24.
Qualified blanket claims: statements about free/commercial use, permission, and attribution apply to images under the standard Unsplash License and do not clear every depicted third-party right.
Added restrictions on unmodified resale and compiling images into a competing service, plus a pointer to additional restrictions in the Terms.
Added image-specific checks for identifiable people, brands, artwork, and locations, and clarified that Unsplash+ has a separate paid license.
Rewrote and synchronized all twelve translations and added official references.
